A modular genomic-ancestry workflow

Connect contamination estimates, principal components and reference-population assignment in Snakemake.

  • Snakemake
  • VerifyBamID2
  • PCA / KNN
Main outcome

A modular workflow for genomic quality control and population assignment.

Motivation

Make ancestry-related quality control and population assignment inspectable as one modular workflow, with explicit reference resources and sample alignment.

Implementation

The workflow connects GRCh38 preparation and VerifyBamID2 outputs to contamination tables, harmonized principal components, a four-PC K-nearest-neighbor classifier and PCA visualizations. Python tests cover table alignment, PC-column parsing and a small synthetic assignment case.

Results

The repository implements the processing stages and synthetic reference tests. Its outputs are contamination summaries, aligned PC tables, population-label tables and plots. No cohort-level accuracy or benchmark measurements are published here.

Limitations

Reference genomes, compatible 1000 Genomes resources and authorized sample inputs are required for a full run. Existing synthetic tests do not validate end-to-end cohort behavior, biological generalization or clinical suitability. No individual genomic records are displayed.

Evidence boundary

Software implementation evidence is distinct from a validated ancestry-inference result.
